title: Igenamiterere
intro: Genzura konti yawe n’igenamiterere ry’iyi sitidiyo.

profile.title: Umwirondoro wawe
profile.subtitle: Uko abandi bakozi bakubona n’uko winjira.
profile.currentPasswordHint: Rirakenewe kugira ngo uhindure imeri winjiriraho.

password.title: Hindura ijambobanga
password.subtitle: Kurihindura bigusohora ku bindi bikoresho byose.
password.rules: Nibura inyuguti {{min}}, ritagizwe n’imibare gusa kandi ridasanzwe cyane.
password.changed: Ijambobanga ryahinduwe. Wasohowe ku bindi bikoresho.

studio.title: Sitidiyo
studio.subtitle: Igenamiterere rya {{studio}}. Hindura ururimi kugira ngo ugenzure indi sitidiyo.
studio.readOnly: Ba nyiri sitidiyo n’abayobozi bayo ni bo bonyine bashobora guhindura iri genamiterere.
studio.autoNormalizeHint: Bireba indirimbo zishyirwaho guhera ubu; izisanzwe zigumana ingano zifite.
studio.loudnessHint: -14 LUFS ni ingano isanzwe kuri streaming; -16 iri hasi gato.
studio.audioSubtitle: Ntihinduka kuri iyi sitidiyo: seriveri ya streaming, encoder ya live n’indirimbo zose zigomba gukoresha setting zidahinduka.

members.title: Abanyamuryango
members.subtitle: Abantu bakora kuri {{studio}} n’icyo buri wese yemerewe gukora.
members.addSubtitle: Ha umuntu uburenganzira bwo kugera kuri {{studio}}.
members.addHint: Andika imeri ya konti isanzweho. Azabona uburenganzira ubutaha naramuka afunguye dashboard.
members.removeConfirmBody: Ahita atakaza uburenganzira kuri iyi sitidiyo. Ushobora kuzongera kumwongeraho nyuma.

roleHints.OWNER: Byose, harimo no gucunga abayobozi na ba nyirayo
roleHints.ADMIN: Byose uretse gucunga abayobozi na ba nyirayo
roleHints.DJ: Ajya live, asimbuka indirimbo kandi agenzura ibiganiro
